rearm_groups.name: pre_channel_receive
rearm_groups.rule: entry arms the common-exit pump; pump re-arms every upstream probe; no probe re-arms itself

rearm_groups.name: secured_decrypt
rearm_groups.rule: entry arms the decrypt-function exit; exit re-arms entry and verdict probes

rearm_groups.name: secured_receive
rearm_groups.rule: entry arms the secured finalize-function exit; exit re-arms recipient and consumer probes

rearm_groups.name: queuez_push
rearm_groups.rule: push entry arms its common return; return re-arms family-update result and object-dispatch probes

rearm_groups.name: queuez_object_apply
rearm_groups.rule: object-apply entry arms its common return; return re-arms slot, decode, key and lifecycle probes

probes.name: rx_dispatch_entry
probes.observe: r13 connection; received type at r13+0x1788; received sequence at r13+0x178a

probes.name: expected_type_result
probes.observe: eax expected reply type returned by message-object vtable+0x18; r12 queue head; r15 queue index

probes.name: sequence_candidate
probes.observe: r12+0x0e stored request sequence; r13+0x178a received sequence; reached only after type match

probes.name: push_type_result
probes.observe: al result of push-handler vtable+0 type acceptance

probes.name: push_matched
probes.observe: received type/sequence; path sets recipient kind 2

probes.name: push_consumer_result
probes.observe: al result of push-handler vtable+8

probes.name: no_recipient
probes.observe: status failed; neither in-flight head nor push handler accepted the received type

probes.name: request_matched
probes.observe: status ok; r12 matched in-flight entry; r14 message object; path sets recipient kind 1

probes.name: request_consumer_result
probes.observe: al result of matched message-object vtable+0x20

probes.name: receive_success
probes.observe: status ok; recipient kind at r13+0x1828 distinguishes request 1 from push 2

probes.name: receive_rearm_pump
probes.observe: common function-exit path; re-arm upstream probes and emit only control counters

probes.name: secured_decrypt_entry
probes.observe: mode-1-only state-6 function; rdi is the BAP connection

probes.name: secured_decrypt_result
probes.observe: al is the return from 0xB32C90 GCM verify/decrypt; r13 points at the decrypted frame buffer on success

probes.name: secured_decrypt_success
probes.observe: success-only branch; r13 begins with the six-byte decrypted BAP inner header

probes.name: secured_decrypt_rearm_pump
probes.observe: common normal exit of the mode-1 decrypt/inner-header function

probes.name: secured_rx_dispatch_entry
probes.observe: mode-1 finalize/recipient-selection function; rdi is the BAP connection

probes.name: secured_expected_type_result
probes.observe: eax is expected reply type returned by in-flight object vtable+0x18; r12 is queue head

probes.name: secured_sequence_candidate
probes.observe: reached only after type match; r12+0x0e holds request sequence and r14+0x178a the received sequence

probes.name: secured_push_type_result
probes.observe: al is the push handler vtable+0 type-acceptance result

probes.name: secured_push_matched
probes.observe: push path accepted the received type and sets recipient kind 2

probes.name: secured_push_consumer_result
probes.observe: al is the return from secured push decode/consume helper 0xB2F550

probes.name: secured_no_recipient
probes.observe: neither in-flight head nor push handler accepted the received type

probes.name: secured_request_matched
probes.observe: in-flight type and sequence matched; path sets recipient kind 1

probes.name: secured_consumer_result
probes.observe: common al verdict after push helper 0xB2F550 or request helper 0xB2F270

probes.name: secured_receive_success
probes.observe: success-only cleanup branch after the common consumer verdict

probes.name: secured_receive_rearm_pump
probes.observe: common normal exit of secured finalize/recipient selection

probes.name: queuez_push_entry
probes.observe: entry of the QueueZ update notification consumer containing the call to queuez_family_update_begin

probes.name: queuez_family_update_result
probes.observe: al is queuez_family_update_begin result; r15d is family and frame locals retain flags, root and object count

probes.name: queuez_family_objects_dispatch
probes.observe: reached only when family update was accepted and decoded object_count is greater than zero

probes.name: queuez_push_rearm_pump
probes.observe: common normal return of the QueueZ update notification consumer

probes.name: queuez_object_apply_entry
probes.observe: one decoded QueueZ object begins application; esi is family, rdx root key pointer and rcx the object record

probes.name: queuez_object_slot_result
probes.observe: rax is the existing or newly allocated registry element returned by 0x56BAB0; zero means no usable slot

probes.name: queuez_rsat_decode_returned
probes.observe: 0x2C9000 has returned after decoding directly into r13; the caller ignores al and finalizes the stream next

probes.name: queuez_object_key_check
probes.observe: rax is decoded object key and rbp-0x75b0 is expected wire SOID; equality is required before lifecycle dispatch

probes.name: queuez_object_key_mismatch
probes.observe: negative-only branch: decoded object key did not equal the wire SOID

probes.name: queuez_object_updated
probes.observe: existing object changed and is about to enter general lifecycle update dispatch 0x56D3F0

probes.name: queuez_object_added
probes.observe: newly populated object passed key validation and is about to enter general lifecycle added dispatch 0x56D290

probes.name: queuez_object_apply_rearm_pump
probes.observe: common normal return of one QueueZ object-apply invocation
